scopes_needed_read: No granular scopes documented; token inherits the authorizing user's access
auth.token_lifetime: 'Mailchimp Marketing access tokens do not expire'
auth.refresh: None needed; valid until user revokes

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: None mentioned on the OAuth guide; self-service 'Register An App' in Mailchimp account
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Customer logs in at login.mailchimp.com authorize URL and approves; we call login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/metadata to obtain the dc (data center) for their API host. Alternative: customer generates an API key in Account > Extras > API keys and shares it.

sandbox.how_to_get: No sandbox found in primary docs; use a free Mailchimp account

rate_limits: 10 simultaneous connections; 429 on exceed; 120-second call timeout
incremental_sync: since_last_changed / since_timestamp_opt filters on list members; since_send_time on campaigns; count/offset pagination (UNVERIFIED parameter names on fetched page)
blockers: Concurrency cap of 10 requires a connection pool.
sources: https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/guides/access-user-data-oauth-2/ - 'Mailchimp Marketing access tokens do not expire'; authorize URL login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/authorize; metadata endpoint
https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/fundamentals/ - 'The Marketing API has a limit of 10 simultaneous connections'
